label: My Cloud Pro Series PR4100 4-bay NAS
description: 4-bay desktop NAS with two Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 ports for failover or link aggregation. There is no expansion slot and no management port.
notes: Onboard: 2x Gigabit Ethernet RJ45. No PCIe slot, no OOB management port. USB 3.0 expansion ports are for drives only.
